summary: Frontend-only testing of TTB KING Discord-themed redesign. All critical flows verified: page loads without console errors, all 7 Telegram CTAs point to correct URL with target=_blank and render the telegram-icon SVG, headings are uppercase, hero CTA is Blurple #5865F2 (rgb(88,101,242)), body background is deep indigo #0E0F2D (rgb(14,15,45)), stat values (15,000+/85%/100+/$0) render, anchor nav links present on desktop, mobile hamburger opens the mobile menu, mobile sticky Telegram CTA appears after scrolling past hero, no horizontal overflow at 1920x1080 or 390x844, and FAQ accordion expands all 7 answers.

issues: Lenis emits a non-blocking warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute...' — cosmetic only, no impact on scrolling. Consider adding position:relative to the Lenis wrapper element.

critical_code_review_comments: FAQ items don't expose a data-testid="faq-item-{i}" wrapper (only faq-answer/faq-trigger were located). Not a bug, but adding an item-level testid would improve test targeting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Discord-themed redesign passes all 8 requested checks on both 1920x1080 and 390x844. Only observation is a non-fatal Lenis warning about container position.
